purpose: Four-row end-to-end smoke of the four direct-baseline calibration cell configurations before the registered 400-row flight: prove serving geometry, prompt assembly, native tool-schema transport, speech-feature packet binding, sealing and official scoring on 4 rows x 4 cells = 16 contacts. This fragment exists because the registered flight fragment a2t-direct-calibration-400-v1 declares the baseline-reproduction profile and a 1,608-call plan; a smoke is a separate, separately registered bounded-discovery-probe run and must carry its own execution_plan rather than borrow the flight's. No smoke number is a task measurement: outputs are inspected for transport and parse legality only, and no smoke result enters any verdict.

smoke_population.selection: the lexicographically first sample of tiers 1, 2, 5 and 6 of the frozen 400 -- the four tiers the calibration acceptance rule reads

execution_plan_basis.why_the_whole_smoke_and_not_one_cell: Attempt budget is enforced RUN-CUMULATIVELY: core.model.adapter.FrozenCoreAdapter re-reads every prior attempt's durable actuals for this run_id on every request and refuses when prior_spent + this_attempt exceeds planned_model_calls. All four cells are attempts of the SAME run id, so a per-cell plan of 4 is exhausted the moment the second cell asks for its first contact -- which is exactly what happened on 2026-09-04 ("allows 4 calls (4 already spent by other attempts on this run)"). A plan must therefore cover prior durable spend plus its own worst case, i.e. the whole smoke.
execution_plan_basis.calls: 4 rows x 1 contact x 4 cells = 16, which is also what the exposure row registers
execution_plan_basis.speech_audio_seconds: 4 x 16.948 = 67.792 across the four cells, rounded up to the integer contracts.ExecutionPlan requires

evaluation.what_is_read: transport legality, parse rate and throughput only
evaluation.what_is_not_read: no smoke metric is a task measurement and none enters a verdict; the calibration's numbers come only from the registered 400-row flight

decision.gate: every cell must complete 4 of 4 contacts, seal a verifiable manifest and score without error before the registered 1,608-call flight is launched
